label: AB3_hP8_162_c_k-001
title: Hexagonal BiI$_{3}$ Structure
comments:
BiI$_{3}$ has also been reported in the \href{current_web_home_dir/AB3_hR8_148_c_f-001}{rhombohedral $D0_{5}$ structure}. The Bi-I bonds are similar in both structures, with the only difference being the stacing of the layers. 
 Note that although the lattice is hexagonal, the symmetry is trigonal.
